example_sentences_in_bangla: পরিবারের ছোট ছেলে হিসেবে তাকে সবাই খুব ভালোবাসে।
গ্রামের ছোট ছেলেরা সকলে একসাথে খেলতে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: As the youngest son of the family, he is loved by everyone.
The youngest sons of the village all go to play together.
note: This is a straightforward familial term often used idiomatically to denote the youngest male child in Bengali households.
